sentences.text:
Petitioner :- Deepak Kumar Tiwari @ Kanhaiyya And 2 Others Respondent :- State Of U.P. Thru. Collector Gonda And 4 Others Counsel for Petitioner :- Pradeep Kumar Shukla Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.,Mohammad Ehtesham Khan Hon'ble Alok Mathur,J.
1.

entities.text: State Of U.P. Thru. Collector Gonda
entities.label: RESPONDENT

sentences.text: Heard Sri Pradeep Kumar Shukla, the learned counsel for the petitioners.

2. Learned Standing Counsel appears for the respondent no.1 and 3 and Shri Shashi Kant Mishra,
learned counsel appearing for the Private Corporation respondent no.4.
3.

The grievance of the petitioners is that the proceedings under Section 18 of the Land Acquisition Act 1894 seeking enhancement of the award was pending before the Special Judge S.C./S.T. Act,
Gonda.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Later, on account of promulgation of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (LARA Act, 2013). The matter pertaining to land acquisition were transferred to the said Tribunal i.e. the respondent no.5.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (LARA Act, 2013)
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
However, the said file relating to the case of the petitioners was neither being adjudicated by the Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Authority, Basti (LARA Tribunal) or the Land Acquisition Tribunal in terms of the old Act.
It is in the aforesaid circumstances that the petitioners had approached this Court by filing the instant petition.

5. The counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the file relating to the case of the petitioners has been transferred to the court of Special Judge SC/ST Act, Gonda as per the notification dated 04.08.2022 regarding creation of LARA Tribunal were all matters relating to Land Acquisition Act to be transferred was sent to the said Tribunal who did not accept the same in absence of any clear order.
6. Be that as it may, since there is notification dated 04.08.2022 for creation of LARA Tribunal in terms of the Act, 2013, accordingly the SC/ST Act, Gonda shall remit the file of Miscellaneous Case No.475 of 2019 to the LARA Tribunal at Basti who upon receipt of the such file registered the same and complete the proceedings after hearing the parties but without granting any unnecessary adjournment as expeditiously as possible preferably within a period of six months, from the date of the receipt of the said records.
7.

It is made clear that the Court has not examined the case of either of the parties on merits and all pleas are left open to be raised before the Tribunal concerned which shall be decided on its own merits.
8. With the aforesaid, the petition is disposed of.

(Alok Mathur, J.) Order Date :- 9.5.2024 Ravi/
